Author: AbP
Description: AbP Map Pack - custom random maps for team games with friends. Included: AbP Trio Stone Lanes, AbP Trio Lanes and AbP Trio Ford (MBA Trio maps with ordered spawns: lobby order = spawn order, teams mirrored across the lanes); AbP Michi Relic Pond and AbP Michi Official Relic Pond (10 relics per player, dockable fish ponds); AbP Black Forest, AbP Sideways Black Forest, AbP Black Boarest v2, AbP Arena and AbP Amazon Tunnel (originals with no-collision trade carts, plus small in-base ponds on Arena and TC fish on Amazon Tunnel); AbP Sideways Black Forest 2 TC (AbP Sideways Black Forest with two town centers per player, Budapest style, each with its own villagers and starting resources); AbP Burrito Brawl 4v4 (team-sided Burrito Brawl, play on Large or bigger); AbP Hideout (WC25 Hideout with no-collision trade carts, a fortified wall, a 9-villager start with a pre-built lumber camp, 2 houses, and fish under the TC); AbP Hideout 2 TC (AbP Hideout plus a second town center outside the wall with its own villagers, gold, berries, deer and woodlines); AbP Mountain Hideout (9 villagers, a fortified wall for every player, and fish under the TC); AbP Onion (original map: a sealed concentric onion of trees, stone and gold around a relic sanctum). Source, map notes, changelog and bug reports: https://github.com/Code-by-AB/aoe2-abp-map-pack
Title: AbP Map Pack
